name: AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
Let your customers save products they love and return later to complete their purchase.

AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce adds a complete wishlist system to your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to save products, organize them into multiple wishlists, share lists with friends and family, and quickly purchase saved items whenever they’re ready.

Wishlists help reduce lost sales by allowing customers to save products instead of leaving your store. Whether shoppers are comparing products, waiting for a sale, planning a future purchase, or creating a gift list, AICOSO Wishlist helps improve customer engagement and encourages repeat visits.

Designed for performance and ease of use, the plugin integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce and provides a fast, responsive wishlist experience on desktop and mobile devices.

Why Use AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce?

Many visitors don’t purchase products during their first visit. A wishlist gives them an easy way to save products and return later instead of forgetting about them.

Wishlist functionality can help your store:

  • Increase repeat visitors
  • Improve customer engagement
  • Reduce abandoned purchases
  • Encourage product sharing
  • Boost conversions through reminder emails and price alerts
  • Help customers organize products they want to purchase later

Features

One-Click Add to Wishlist

Customers can add products to their wishlist instantly using AJAX without reloading the page.

Guest Wishlist Support

Visitors can create wishlists even without creating an account. Guest wishlists can later be converted into permanent wishlists after registration.

Multiple Wishlists

Registered customers can create multiple wishlists for different occasions such as birthdays, gift ideas, home projects, or future purchases.

Wishlist Sharing

Allow customers to share wishlists using a public link or social media, helping increase product visibility and referrals.

Variable Product Support

Supports WooCommerce variable products, allowing customers to save the exact product variation including size, color, or style.

Quick Add to Cart

Customers can move wishlist items directly to the shopping cart with a single click.

Price Drop Notifications

Automatically notify customers when products saved in their wishlist go on sale, encouraging them to complete their purchase.

Automated Reminder Emails

Send scheduled reminder emails to encourage customers to return and purchase saved products.

Wishlist Analytics

Monitor popular wishlist products and customer interest to better understand buying trends and plan promotions.

WooCommerce Blocks Compatible

Fully compatible with WooCommerce Blocks, Classic themes, and modern WooCommerce checkout experiences.

Responsive Design

Optimized for desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Feature Summary

  • AJAX Add to Wishlist
  • Guest Wishlist Support
  • Multiple Wishlists
  • Wishlist Sharing
  • Variable Product Support
  • Quick Add to Cart
  • Price Drop Notifications
  • Automated Reminder Emails
  • Wishlist Analytics
  • WooCommerce Blocks Compatible
  • Responsive Design
  • Translation Ready

Perfect For

AICOSO Wishlist is ideal for:

  • Fashion and clothing stores
  • Electronics stores
  • Furniture and home decor shops
  • Gift stores
  • Jewelry stores
  • Beauty and cosmetic shops
  • Sports equipment stores
  • Book stores
  • Any WooCommerce store that wants to improve customer retention and increase repeat purchases

Turn Browsers Into Buyers Today with AICOSO!

Any customer who visits your store and does not complete a purchase is still a potential customer.

Therefore, the AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin system will give these customers a reason to return, and will provide you with tools to encourage these customers to return via price alerts, reminders, and a surreal wishlist experience.

Support

For support, please visit https://aicoso.com/support

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores user wishlist data in your WordPress database. For guest users, temporary session data is stored using cookies. No data is sent to external servers except when using social sharing features (at user’s discretion).
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Aicoso Wishlist”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Via FTP

  1. Extract the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the aicoso-wishlist-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. AICOSO Wishlist works with any properly coded WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce.

Can guest users create wishlists?

Yes. Guest visitors can save products without creating an account. Their wishlist can later be converted into a permanent wishlist after registration.

Can customers create multiple wishlists?

Yes. Registered customers can create and manage multiple wishlists.

Does the plugin support variable products?

Yes. Customers can save specific product variations including size, color, and other attributes.

Can customers share their wishlist?

Yes. Wishlists can be shared using social media or direct links.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. It is fully compatible with WooCommerce Blocks and modern checkout experiences.

Can customers move wishlist items directly to the cart?

Yes. Products can be added directly from the wishlist to the shopping cart.

Can reminder emails be customized?

Yes. Email templates can be customized through plugin settings or overridden from your theme.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. Customer wishlist data is stored within your WordPress database. Guest wishlists use browser cookies until the customer creates an account. No customer information is sent to external services unless the user explicitly shares their wishlist.

Privacy

Wishlist information is stored inside your WordPress database.

For guest users, temporary wishlist information is stored using browser cookies until they register or clear their browser data.

The plugin does not transmit customer data to external servers. Information is only shared externally when customers voluntarily use wishlist sharing features.
